bibliography.title: Phenotypic, Genomic, and Transcriptomic Comparison of Industrial Aspergillus oryzae Used in Chinese and Japanese Soy Sauce: Analysis of Key Proteolytic Enzymes Produced by Koji Molds
bibliography.authors: Lijie Zhang; Le Kang; Yan Xu

claims.locator: Results, Phenotypic comparison of three industrial Aspergillus oryzae strains, paragraph discussing Figure 2B
claims.scope: Ranges reported across three industrial Aspergillus oryzae strains during a 46-hour koji fermentation

claims.locator: Materials and Methods, Enzyme activity assays
claims.scope: Crude enzyme extract prepared from 5 g koji and 45 mL liquid, stirred at 40 degrees Celsius for one hour

methods.neutral-protease: Modified protease assay in pH 7.2 phosphate buffer; one unit corresponds to color equivalent to 1 microgram tyrosine in 1 mL reaction solution per minute at 40 degrees Celsius.
methods.acidic-protease: Modified protease assay in pH 3.0 lactic acid buffer; one unit corresponds to color equivalent to 1 microgram tyrosine in 1 mL reaction solution per minute at 40 degrees Celsius.
methods.leucine-aminopeptidase: Leucine p-nitroaniline assay; one unit corresponds to production of 1 microgram p-nitroaniline per minute at 40 degrees Celsius.

public_boundary: The values are literature context for three industrial strains, not a Complete99 product, supplier, recipe, lot, process guarantee, or operating instruction.
The ranges must remain attached to the 46-hour study context and the reported assay definitions.
The article identifies candidate proteolytic enzymes and explicitly calls for further functional confirmation.
